historical_preservation.note: Protect historical Lean sources/evidence and nonimported completed objects. S11c files are excluded from this work; concurrent changes by their owner are not falsely treated as writes by this increment. Native fidelity inputs are checked at the precise current bytes. Imported old objects may be rebuilt without rewriting historical records.
